benchmark.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event WHERE session_id=? AND occurred_at>=?
after_plan: SEARCH event USING COVERING INDEX event_session_time (session_id=? AND occurred_at>?)

real_results.sample_rule: At least 3 events before 2015-08-01 UTC; smallest 50000 SHA256(13112026:visitorid). No future activity used.
real_results.catalog_rule: Items observed in selected cohort before prediction cutoff; actual sellability unknown.
limitations: Price, quantity, seller, readable item names and exposure logs are not inferred.
Identifiers are visitors, not verified persons; timestamps are historical 2015.
Metrics apply only to users with novel purchases of pre-cutoff-known items.
